name: data-cost-notice
title: Data Cost Notice
description: On Data Saver, mobile data or a slow connection (Network Information API, or a Save-Data hint you pass) shows the size and an honest rough time, offers a lighter version with what it saves, or waits for Wi-Fi and then starts by itself.

meta.stops: Big download ate the mobile data pack
meta.summary: On mobile data, Data Saver or a slow line, shows a big download's size and rough time and offers a lighter version or waiting for Wi-Fi.
catches: Large downloads, uploads or autoplay on mobile data
Slow connections, with a rough time estimate
A lighter version and how much it saves
limits: The Network Information API is not available in every browser (notably Safari and Firefox); without it, pass connection details yourself
Chrome caps reported bandwidth at 10 Mbps, so times are rough and fast lines aren't called slow
"Wait for Wi-Fi" relies on the browser reporting the connection type
a11y: Notice content is a role="status" region
Version choices are a labelled role="group" of buttons
The waiting pulse only animates when motion is allowed
